findings.text: rail.js `pick()` (diff line ~60): the "ai" tab shows no body and relies on the chat above being the AI tab. That fits the owner's "same as the sidebar" ask, but the "dictation" tab embeds a second dictation widget below the sheet's own, which may fight for the mic. Worth a 400 px look.

rail.css: `.drawer-rail-sheet-chat-only { }` is an empty rule and can be deleted. `.drawer-rail-sheet-tabs` sets `flex: 0 1 45%` while chat-only overrides it to `0 0 auto`; check the chat keeps enough height at 400 px.

The diff has no screenshots or mic-proof output, so I could not confirm the proofs in requirements.md (mic-proof, 400 px full-state shot, four-width layout check). HEAD of `ext/drawer/rail.js` does not yet contain `mount_tabs`, though commit 4cb0adf91 exists, so the work may not be merged yet and `merge.mjs` should be confirmed.

Simplicity: the change reuses `tabs.shown()`, `tabs.context()` and `tab.load()` and overrides only `state()`, which is close to the simplest route. The `append(...(() => {...})())` IIFE in `mount_tabs` could be two plain lines.
